# SOP-P2-L4-01 Line startup - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, EQ-P2-L4-HP03

Related documents: ECN-2026-045, SB-1007, SOP-P2-L4-02

Preconditions
1. Verify maintenance log entries for EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, EQ-P2-L4-HP03 are complete and signed.  
2. Confirm utilities are available and stable per plant procedures; confirm furnace area is cleared of obstructions and nonessential personnel.  
3. Confirm all safety interlocks are in place and visible status indicators show normal.

Lubricant information
4. The lubricant part number for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is CFW-LUB-450.  
5. The lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is CFW-LUB-723.

PPE
6. Required PPE for startup: hard hat, safety glasses with side shields, hearing protection, flame-resistant clothing, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, and face shield when applicable. Ensure PPE is inspected and fitted before entering the equipment area.

Startup sequence (operator)
7. Perform visual inspection of EQ-P2-L4-HT02 and adjacent conveyors. Verify no foreign material in load path. Confirm control panel access is unobstructed.  
8. Energize control system following plant control-room authorization and observe control alarms; do not bypass alarms. Monitor for abnormal sounds or smells; if observed, stop and notify maintenance.  
9. Initiate low-speed jog or diagnostics per equipment control prompts to confirm movement, then transition to normal run mode when prompted by the control system.

Shutdown and abnormal conditions
10. If any fault persists, follow lockout/tagout per SB-1007 and notify supervision. Document condition and steps taken; reference ECN-2026-045 if component change is required.

Sign-off
11. Operator name, signature, and date required in logbook upon successful startup. Maintenance and shift supervisor sign-off required before production begins.

References: ECN-2026-045, SB-1007, SOP-P2-L4-02
